description: Land Acquisition - Ihalagama and Medagama, Ihalagama, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District - Magalegoda and Bemmulla, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition for public purposes under the Land Acquisition Act. The content focuses exclusively on land matters without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or electoral matters.
